# WorkElate Chief, the Brain · aina.workelate.com

> WorkElate Chief, the Brain, is one memory across the systems a 200 to 2,000 person company already runs, made by WorkElate and installed by WE_AINA, WorkElate's own studio: it reads what your CRM, mail, tickets and documents already record, judges what needs a person, and asks before it changes anything.

This site has three zones. `/` is the WorkElate Excellence Studio umbrella. `/brain/*` and `/book-a-demo` are the product pages for WorkElate Chief. `/studio/*` is WE_AINA, the studio that installs it. The same definition above is the one used on /brain, on /brain/faq, on /brain/compare and in the Organization schema on every page.

## What it is, in plain terms

- Name: WorkElate Chief. On these pages it is also called "the Brain". Both names refer to one product; there is no separate product called "the Brain".
- Made by: WorkElate (https://www.workelate.com/). Installed and run by WE_AINA, WorkElate's own studio, led by Chitransh (IIM Mumbai) and Pratik (IIT Bombay).
- For: companies of 200 to 2,000 people ($50M to $1B revenue) that already run a CRM, mail, a ticket or project tool, documents and chat, and want one memory across them without replacing any of them.
- Not: a new application people have to live in, an enterprise search product, an integration platform (iPaaS/RPA), or a per-app copilot. See the comparison pages below for the named differences.
- How it acts: fifteen verbs (find, read, research, recall, remember, ask, create, edit, improve, delete, send, share, schedule, assign, judge) resolving to 287 actions across 12 application surfaces and 190 business objects. 71 of those actions send, delete or share, and each stops for a person's yes before it runs.
- Interruptions are budgeted: at most 40 per organization per hour and 5 per person per hour by default, changeable by saying so in plain language.
- Honesty: when it says it did something, the record is re-read to prove it exists, and the sentence it wrote is checked against what the tools returned.
- Commercials: a two-week Diagnostic Sprint at a fixed fee quoted after a short call, then a build at a fixed price of $30K to $100K, scoped before work starts. The customer owns the code, the data and the system at handover. No seat licence.
- Proof on record (RockProsUSA, building materials, 13 quarries): dispatch cycle time 38% lower; 2,140 invoices processed with zero manual touches; 11,200 operations hours returned in the first year.
- Contact: chitransh@workelate.com. The one call to action across the site is "Book a Diagnostic Sprint".

## Product pages (the Brain)

- [Overview](https://aina.workelate.com/brain): what is installed, the four numbers, depth over app count, what it will not do.
- [Capabilities](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/capabilities): every capability in plain language, one page each (signal capture, work graph, ranked briefing, confirm gate, read after write, claim check, honest refusal, interruption budget, and more).
- [Architecture](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/architecture): one process for every change, no hand-written rules per app.
- [Use cases](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/use-cases): client delivery, order to cash, mail triage and board reporting, each walked end to end.
- [Questions](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/faq): twelve buyer questions with short answers, including what it is and what it does when nobody types.
- [Objections](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/objections): the eight objections that decide a deal, and the four situations where the Brain is the wrong buy.
- [Proof and limits](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/proof): what is claimed and what is not.
- [Security review](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/security): it acts only as the person who signed in; nothing it reads can change what it is allowed to do.
- [Pricing](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/pricing): the Sprint, the build, ownership at handover.
- [Getting started](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/getting-started): one system connected read only, a real week replayed, one workflow live by week ten.
- [For the CIO](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/for/cio), [For the COO](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/for/coo), [For revenue](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/for/revenue): the same product from three seats.
- [Glossary](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/glossary): work graph, signal, judgment, interruption budget, confirm gate, defined once.
- [Roadmap](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/roadmap) and [Changelog](https://aina.workelate.com/brain/changelog): shipped, building, next.
- [Book a demo](https://aina.workelate.com/book-a-demo): 45 minutes, a real week replayed, no slideware.
